svg.aria-label: An animated diagram of atc. You ask an orchestrator on your laptop for an orders page, and it spawns builder-ui on a sprite. builder-ui asks builder-api, on an imp microVM, what the API returns. When builder-ui needs approval to deploy, the request rises through the atc gateway into your inbox. You clear it, and builder-ui deploys a preview.

g.text: You ask your orchestrator for an orders page.
It spawns a builder on another machine.
Agents talk to each other directly.
A request for you lands in your inbox.
You clear it there, whichever agent asked.
The builder deploys and carries on.
build the orders page on a sprite
